purpose: Markantere Überarbeitung der drei gelassenen Hochsee-Cenyric mit stärkeren individuellen Merkmalen
userRequirements: Abgesottene Ausstrahlung und gelassene Posen erhalten

variants.title: 1 · Narbennase
variants.idea: Kantiger Deckveteran mit stark eingekerbtem Ohr, alter Nasennarbe und asymmetrischer weißer Gesichtszeichnung.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: revised Aleria Cenyric companion portrait. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its exact calm pose, ship setting, framing and clean anime art style, but substantially redesign the CAT'S individual identifying features as specified. The previous cat was too ordinary. Create a memorable CHARACTER DESIGN that can be recognized at thumbnail size from face shape, fur silhouette and unusual natural physical traits. Use deliberate clear stylization and stronger feline facial structure, not a generic pretty cat face.
Bildformat 2:3. Tales of Xillia/Frieren Anime Art Style. Markante, überzeichnete Gesichtszüge und Proportionen, starke Mimik, klare Anime-Lineart und sauberes Cel-Shading. Weiche, simple Anime-Texturen für Haut, Stoff, Holz, Stein und Hintergrund. Keine realistischen Texturen, kein Fotorealismus, keine malerische Darstellung.
Invariants: ORANGE TABBY with darker ginger-orange stripes, broad WHITE BELLY and white chest. Natural domestic cat anatomy, exactly four legs. Preserve the target's completely CALM seated or reclining pose, relaxed heavy-lidded composure, healthy robust build, wooden ship environment and OPEN OCEAN background. The cat is a hardened seafarer's animal companion, utterly unbothered at rest. CLOSED mouth, no grin, no jumping, movement, action, distress or aggression. All facial injuries mentioned are OLD and fully HEALED, just quiet identifying marks, no blood or fresh wound. Emphasize the listed traits clearly instead of hiding them in fine texture.
No clothing, bandana, hat, eyepatch, jewelry, extra props, people, additional animals, captions, lettering, border, watermark, collage, realism or 3D. Do not add a cloudy eye or copy the previous elderly mane tomcat. Keep the complete cat silhouette inside the 2:3 frame with a comfortable margin.
Redesign 1 — SCAR NOSE. Keep the original grounded seated pose beside the wooden bollard. Change the head into a visibly BROAD SQUARE mature tomcat head, strong blocky muzzle, prominent jowls and low thick ginger fur eyebrows above small OLIVE-GREEN eyes. A clearly visible substantial old missing notch at the outer third of ONE ear gives the ear a distinctive broken silhouette; smooth healed edges, no wound. An OLD thin pale DIAGONAL SCAR crosses the bridge of the nose and interrupts the orange fur pattern, visible but not graphic. Nose leather is dark dusty pink and asymmetrical. Strong uneven white facial marking: a WHITE blaze offset from the center that widens over one cheek and the chin, leaving the opposite cheek mostly orange. Coarse short orange tabby fur with rough little tufts, dark burnt-orange tiger bands, white chest and broad white belly. Unequal white front socks, one higher than the other. The face should communicate a quiet uncompromising old deck boss, not cute, angry or sad. Strongly identifiable ear silhouette, square face and pale nasal scar are the focal changes. Preserve the resting curled tail and planted paws.
